query:
UPDATE products SET name = 'The Diplomat', description = 'East meets streetwear. Mandarin collar in structured cotton with a clean, minimal silhouette. No tie required. No explanation either.

MATERIALS:
97% cotton, 3% elastane
180 GSM poplin with stretch
Slim fit
Mandarin band collar
Hidden button placket
Darted back for shape

CARE:
Machine wash cold
Tumble dry low or hang dry
Iron on medium heat
Do not bleach' WHERE id = 80004;
UPDATE products SET name = 'The Understatement', description = 'The tee that does less and says more. Heather gray V-neck in a cotton-poly blend that drapes without clinging. No logo, no graphic — just cut and fabric doing the work.

MATERIALS:
60% cotton, 40% polyester
160 GSM heathered jersey
Regular fit
V-neck
Double-stitched hems
Tag-free neck label

CARE:
Machine wash cold
Tumble dry low
Do not bleach
Iron on low heat if needed' WHERE id = 80005;
UPDATE products SET name = 'The Boardroom', description = 'Crisp white oxford that looks like it costs three times what it does. Button-down collar, single-needle stitching, and a fit that works tucked or untucked. The shirt that shows up even when you don''t want to.

MATERIALS:
100% premium oxford cotton
140 GSM
Regular fit
Button-down collar
Single-needle side seams
Adjustable barrel cuffs
Box pleat back

CARE:
Machine wash warm
Tumble dry medium
Iron on medium-high heat
Do not bleach
Dry clean safe' WHERE id = 30007;
UPDATE products SET name = 'The Redirect', description = 'Light blue oxford for the days you need to look approachable but still in charge. Same construction as The Boardroom, different energy. Pairs with navy, charcoal, or khaki.

MATERIALS:
100% premium oxford cotton
140 GSM
Regular fit
Button-down collar
Single-needle side seams
Adjustable barrel cuffs
Box pleat back

CARE:
Machine wash warm
Tumble dry medium
Iron on medium-high heat
Do not bleach
Dry clean safe' WHERE id = 30008;
UPDATE products SET name = 'The Workhorse', description = 'Chambray that bridges the gap between office and off-duty. Soft enough to roll the sleeves, structured enough to keep a collar. Gets better with age.

MATERIALS:
100% cotton chambray
150 GSM
Regular fit
Point collar
Chest pocket
Button cuffs
Back yoke with box pleat

CARE:
Machine wash cold
Tumble dry low
Iron on medium heat
Do not bleach
Expect natural fading over time' WHERE id = 30009;
UPDATE products SET name = 'The Heritage', description = 'Washed chambray with a lived-in feel from day one. Indigo dye that fades the way denim should — on your terms. Chest pocket, button cuffs, and a collar that sits right without starch.

MATERIALS:
100% cotton chambray
150 GSM
Relaxed fit
Point collar
Chest pocket
Button cuffs
Indigo wash

CARE:
Machine wash cold, inside out
Tumble dry low
Iron on medium heat
Do not bleach
Color will develop natural patina' WHERE id = 60005;
